#Text=fix: Comic Shanns issues, new fonts structure (#8641)
#Text=fix: Comic Shanns issues, new fonts structure
#Text=Fixes https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/8327
#Text=Adopted https://github.com/jesusmgg/comic-shanns-mono with few modifications:
#Text=- cleared unnecessary characters for box drawings and braille
#Text=- added polish Ł & ł from https://github.com/kaBeech/serious-shanns/tree/main
#Text=- corrected `tumed question mark` glyph
#Text=Also done:
#Text=- unified prod font paths across `excalidraw-app`, OSS package (host apps, examples, E+), and CDN into `fonts/[FontFamilyName]/[FontFamilyName]-*.woff2`
#Text=- grouping into subfolders per font family ✅
#Text=- unification of `EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH` for OSS and E+ ✅ (instead of one relying on "/" while the other on "/fonts/")
#Text=- unified and organized `excalidraw-app/build` & `excalidraw/dist/prod/` into `fonts/` folder ✅ (instead of having all on root)
#Text=[изображение]
#Text=- host apps can just copy the whole "fonts" folder instead of all the woff2 files ✅
#Text=- split all non-deprecated fonts into multiple chunks (atm only Excalifont and Comic Shanns left) and related:
#Text=- stopped adding vite `-[hash]` suffix to fonts on `excalidraw-app` build (we have hashes thanks to the split)
#Text=- optimized fetch during export to force cache
#Text=- stopped preloading Virgil, as at this point it's unnecessary for new scenes, while old scenes will mostly get it from the cache or just fetch it on init if needed
#Text=Fixes:
